text: Refinement types (as in F* or Liquid Haskell) extend simple types with:
choices: predicates on values: {x:T | φ(x)}, giving a form of dependent types oriented towards program verification
explanation: Refinement types: {x:T | φ(x)} where φ is a predicate. This allows types like {n:Int | n>0} (positive integers) without full dependent types. SMT solvers discharge proof obligations.
